dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #Sorry about that, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. The patient's condition was a bit tricky, so it took a while to deal with.

choices.text: You must be exhausted. Here, have a drink.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And here's a special snack, too. Hope it gets your strength back up!

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: To be honest, though, things like this don't really tire me out. It's more that I just can't wrap my head around it.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: At the start of every children's film, they clearly state: "All events and products in this film are purely fictional. Please do not try to imitate them." And yet, fully-grown adults end up doing just that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is it because they aren't paying any attention when they're watching? Or is it some rebellious mentality — a "whatever you tell me not to do, I'll do it just to prove you wrong" type of thing?

choices.text: Not much we can do if they don't read the warnings at all.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: Hmm, maybe this is starting to get a bit too deep...

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: If I get a chance, I'll speak to His Grace and Monsieur Neuvillette to see if we can think of a way to prevent such issues.

response.speaker: Sigewinne
response.text: For now, let's focus on Mellow Manor instead. I might be late, but I'm here now!

choices.text: But deliberately ignoring them... That's another thing altogether.
We made you some fruit tea.
